meta.name: happyhorse
meta.description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成并编辑视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI快速生成或编辑视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit videos with text or images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or edit videos using AI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行调用阿里 HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成和编辑视频。支持文字转视频、图片转视频、参考图保持角色生成视频，以及用自然语言编辑已有视频。可输出 720P 或 1080P，最长 15 秒。
howto.when: 当你提到“happyhorse”、“阿里视频”、“视频编辑 AI”等关键词，或要求生成/编辑视频时触发。

say.text: 用 HappyHorse 生成一段马在草地上奔跑的视频。
say.note: 触发 T2V 模型生成视频。

say.text: 把这张图片变成视频，镜头缓慢推进。
say.note: 触发 I2V 模型，需要提供图片链接。

say.text: 编辑这个视频，把背景换成雪景。
say.note: 触发 Video Edit 模型，需要提供视频链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate and edit videos using Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via CLI. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video with character preservation, and video editing with natural language. Outputs up to 720P/1080P, 15 seconds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "happyhorse", "alibaba video", "video editing AI", or ask to generate/edit a video.

say_en.text: Use HappyHorse to generate a video of a horse galloping in a meadow.
Turn this image into a video with a slow camera zoom.
say_en.note: Triggers I2V model, requires image URL.

say_en.text: Edit this video, change the background to a snowy landscape.
say_en.note: Triggers Video Edit model, requires video URL.
